metas.name: Airplane Trekker
metas.note: A tripod was used to capture the interior of the Hamad International Airport. A unique tripod that captured the inside of a plane can also be seen here. (I only included 1 loc of the airplane trekker just cause its famous).
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Al Bayt Stadium
metas.note: Al Bayt Stadium can be recognized by the black and white horizontal stripes on the stadium along with the tent-like roof.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Black Box Left
metas.note:
This black box on the left side of the bed is seen southeast of Ar-Rayyan, around the green area.

NOTE: The box will not always be visible. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Black Box Right
metas.note:
The black box on the right side of the bed is seen in Al Khor, and in the green area around The Torch Tower and Khalifa International Stadium.

NOTE: The box will not always be visible. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Bollard 1
metas.note:
Bollards in Qatar are only found on a few roads, and you can easily tell them apart.

The horizontal road just west of Qatar map label uses black and yellow centre lines (1). This road doesnt exist now and this is the only loc on that road, with where you can see the blue chevron.

The horizontal road south of Madinat al Ka`ban has a lot more greenery and, the coverage is also very overcast (2).

The coastal road south of Fuwayrit has coastal shrubs all around, and you can often see the coast (3).

If the road doesn’t fit the above descriptions, guess on the long vertical road west of Qatar map label (4).
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Dual Arches (Khalifa International Stadium)
metas.note: Khalifa International Stadium can be recognized by the dual arches shaped like a wide open mouth.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Education City Signs
metas.note: Brown street signs, often fixed to the ground, are seen in Education City.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Education City Stadium
metas.note: Education City Stadium can be recognized by the large, grey cladding with a diamond pattern.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Education City Tiles
metas.note: Education City features distinct black-tiled roads.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Fairly Long Antenna
metas.note: This fairly long antenna is found in and around Doha.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Gahfiya (Ahmed bin Ali Stadium)
metas.note: A structure resembling a gahfiya can be seen around the Ahmed bin Ali Stadium, in Rawdat Al Jahhaniya district.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Long Antenna
metas.note: This long antenna is mostly found in southwestern Qatar.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Lusail 4 Towers
metas.note: Four towers, resembling a screw thread, can be seen from almost every point in Lusail.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Lusail Cardboard Box
metas.note:
This cardboard box in the right side of the bed is seen in Lusail. The rusty clips will also be visible.

NOTE: The box will not always be visible. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Lusail Stadium
metas.note: Lusail Stadium, in Lusail, can be recognized by its golden bowl-like shape.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Mall of Qatar
metas.note: The Mall of Qatar in Rawdat Al Jahhaniya can be recognized by the boxy appearance with many ads on the side of the building. Large car parks are also seen next to the mall.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Short Antenna
metas.note: This very short antenna is found in northern Qatar.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.

metas.name: Torch Tower
metas.note: The Torch Tower can be seen from almost every point in the Baaya District, and can be recognized by its hyperboloid structure, along with it being the tallest building in Qatar.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/qatar.
